text: MTLRD[p,mu,n,nb] denotes the perpendicular component in the lightcone decomposition of the metric tensor g^{\mu \nu} along the vectors n and nb in \(D\) dimensions. It corresponds to \(g^{\mu \nu}_{\perp}\).
Overview, Pair, FVLND, FVLPD, SPLPD, SPLND, SPLRD, MTLPD, MTLND.

MTLRD[\[Mu], \[Nu], n, nb] // FCI // StandardForm (*Pair[LightConePerpendicularComponent[LorentzIndex[\[Mu], D], Momentum[n, D], Momentum[nb, D]], LightConePerpendicularComponent[LorentzIndex[\[Nu], D], Momentum[n, D], Momentum[nb, D]]]*)
MTLRD[\[Mu], \[Nu], n, nb] FVLPD[q, \[Mu], n, nb] // Contract
